question: Who among the following has played the highest number of ODI matches as the Captain of the Indian cricket team, as of 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mahendra Singh Dhoni**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mahendra Singh Dhoni** has played the highest number of **ODI matches as the Captain** of the Indian cricket team.
 
• He captained the Indian cricket team in **200 ODIs** from **2007 to 2018**.
 
• Under his captaincy, India won several major tournaments including the **2007 ICC T20 World Cup**, the **2011 ICC Cricket World Cup**, and the **2013 ICC Champions Trophy**.
 
• Dhoni is known for his **calm demeanor** and excellent **leadership skills**.
 
• He has been a pivotal figure in Indian cricket, often referred to as **Captain Cool** for his ability to stay composed under pressure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Kapil Dev**__

 __
 
• **Kapil Dev** was the captain of the Indian cricket team when they won their first **ICC Cricket World Cup in 1983**.
 
• He is considered one of the greatest all-rounders in the history of cricket.
 
 
 
• **Sachin Ramesh Tendulkar**__
 __
 
• **Sachin Tendulkar**, also known as the **Master Blaster**, is regarded as one of the greatest batsmen in the history of cricket.
 
• Though he has captained the Indian team, his tenure was not as successful as his batting career.
 
 
 
• **Virat Kohli**__
 
 
• **Virat Kohli** took over the captaincy from Dhoni and has been a successful captain in his own right.
 
• He has led India to numerous victories in ODIs and Test matches.
